data.summary: Synthetic demo analysis for headset-stand at as-of 2026-10-24 using rule demo-direct. Target revenue margin 5%: undiscounted price BRL 31.38 with contribution BRL 1.5753 and revenue margin 5.02%; 10% discount lowers charged price to BRL 28.24 and contribution to BRL -1.2507, so contribution turns negative and revenue margin becomes -4.43%.
assumptions: Product and rule are demonstration fixtures with confirmed synthetic provenance only; not business data.
All charges are applied on the common revenue basis from the stored rule: 10% channel fee, 0% tax, 0% advertising, plus BRL 2 fixed fee.
Failure provision included by the deterministic engine uses the stored 10% failure rate and full-print retry assumption.
Discount is applied after pricing; the discounted case is evaluated on the same target price.
Contribution is not net profit; unmodeled overhead is excluded.
limitations: Synthetic demonstration data only; no marketplace verification.
Unmodeled overhead is excluded, including admin, storage, shipping, returns beyond the retry assumption, and any marketplace-specific changes.
Full-print retry assumption is embedded in the deterministic cost model.
No current Shopee fees are available, and this rule is explicitly not Shopee.
